title: Question words
explanation: Chinese question words stay in the answer's position — no fronting like English. 什么 (what), 谁 (who), 哪 (which), 怎么 (how), 为什么 (why), 多少 (how many/much), 几 (how few).
structure: Subj + Verb + Question Word  |  Question Word + Verb + Obj

examples.english: How to get to the station?
How many books do you have?

notes: 哪儿/哪里 (where) are interchangeable. 几 for small numbers (<10), 多少 for larger. 怎么 = how (method), 怎么样 = how about/what do you think. Question word position = answer position.
